decisions.reason: As a close-to-core formwork product given its own page, it likely meets at least provisional aspiration levels and the expanding firm has enough slack to keep testing it in the market.
This automation-oriented product fits the firm's strategic push into efficient processes and automation, so management is likely to retain it absent clear evidence of underperformance.
